description: Check that a stay is free for the given dates and guests, and return the total price (cleaning included), the cancellation policy and a direct booking link with dates and guests already filled in. Give the link to the traveller: they confirm and pay securely on OkeyStay. Never ask the traveller for card details in the chat.
